tech_stack.architecture: Monolithic WebForms with SQL Server backend

findings.title: No Programmatic API — WebForms Only
findings.description: The application is a legacy ASP.NET WebForms app that renders server-side HTML pages. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Integration requires UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No programmatic API. Only browser-rendered WebForms UI.
findings.recommendation: Build a REST API layer exposing timesheet read/write operations.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses ASP.NET Forms authentication with browser-based session cookies. No support for service account authentication, client credentials OAuth 2.0, API keys, or mTLS.
findings.gap: No machine identity mechanism. Authentication is exclusively human-interactive.
findings.recommendation: Introduce OAuth 2.0 client credentials or API key authentication for programmatic access with principal attribution.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: INSERT operations have no idempotency key, no unique constraints, no duplicate detection. Repeated submissions create duplicate timesheet entries.
findings.gap: Non-idempotent writes — repeated submissions create duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency keys and unique business-key constraints on (employee_id, entry_date, project).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The application exposes write operations (INSERT INTO timesheets) with no idempotency protection. Agents retry on failure and LLM non-determinism causes duplicate calls.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Write Operations
findings.description: Direct SQL INSERT with no transaction management, no saga pattern, no compensation logic, and no undo endpoints. Once inserted, entries cannot be reversed.
findings.gap: No compensation or rollback capability. INSERT operations immediately committed.
findings.recommendation: Implement SQL transactions and soft-delete/status lifecycle for reversal capability.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation mechanism.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing multi-step workflows have no rollback path. Failed operations leave partial state.

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging of any kind. Write operations have no principal attribution, no timestamp recording, no immutable log trail.
findings.gap: Complete absence of audit logging and immutable log storage.
findings.recommendation: Implement audit logging with principal attribution and immutable storage (CloudWatch Logs, S3 with object lock).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents must have full audit attribution. No logging exists to track agent-initiated operations.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Single database user for all operations. No role-based access control differentiation. All authenticated users share identical permissions.
findings.gap: No mechanism to scope down agent access per capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based authorization with separate read/write database roles.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. All authenticated users can read and write equally with no permission differentiation.
findings.gap: No fine-grained RBAC or ABAC policies.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization (separate read vs write permissions).

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: InProc session-based identity only. No JWT parsing, no OAuth2 token exchange, no on-behalf-of flow.
findings.gap: No identity propagation mechanism for agent-on-behalf-of-user scenarios.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT/OAuth-based identity propagation distinguishing agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.

findings.title: Plaintext Credentials in Configuration
findings.description: Database credentials embedded in plaintext in web.config (User ID=ts_app;Password=Time2006!). No secrets management, no rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded plaintext credentials with no rotation or encryption.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation. Remove plaintext credentials.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual identities. Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent.
findings.gap: No identity suspension mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent-identity revocation capability (API key deletion or IAM role deactivation).

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conditional writes. Multiple agents can submit overlapping entries with no conflict detection.
findings.gap: Complete absence of concurrency controls.
findings.recommendation: Add version fields and optimistic locking. Implement ETag-based concurrency in API layer.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application middleware. Runaway agent loop could overwhelm SQL Server.
findings.gap: Complete absence of rate limiting.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling before exposing endpoints to agents.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. Agent could submit unlimited timesheet entries with no per-session or per-caller caps.
findings.gap: No business-domain caps on operation scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-agent transaction limits (e.g., max_entries_per_day).

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. INSERT commits immediately with no intermediate reviewable state.
findings.gap: All write operations immediately committed with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.recommendation: Add status-based lifecycle (DRAFT → PENDING → APPROVED) to timesheet entries.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. All operations execute immediately upon form submission.
findings.gap: No mechanism to require human approval for specific operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for agent-initiated write operations.

findings.title: No Data Access Differentiation
findings.description: Employee timesheet data stored with no access control differentiation. Single database user can access all employee records. B2 fires: no access differentiation.
findings.gap: No access differentiation between sensitive data domains. Single permission grants access to all employee data.
findings.recommendation: Implement row-level security and OAuth scope differentiation for employee data access.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Stage A: Yes (employee-specific timesheet data). B1: CLEAR (no highly sensitive fields like SSN/financial instruments returned). B2: RISK-SAFETY (no access differentiation). B3: INFO (no classification metadata). Overall: RISK-SAFETY.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: B2 fires because a single database user (ts_app) has undifferentiated access to all employee records. No OAuth scopes or role granularity exists.

b1.reasoning: Data returned (entry_date, hours, project) does not include highly sensitive fields. Employee_id is an identifier but not PII like SSN or financial data.

b2.reasoning: Single database user with no row-level security. No OAuth scopes distinguishing own-data vs all-data access.

findings.title: Undocumented Data Residency
findings.description: No data residency documentation or configuration. Database at fixed IP (10.0.6.15) with no region/compliance context. Unknown whether sending employee data to LLM in another region violates regulations.
findings.gap: Unknown residency constraints for employee data. No compliance documentation.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Configure same-region LLM endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: residency is undocumented rather than actively violated. No evidence of cross-region data transfer. Finding is absence of documentation, not presence of violation.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: While agent_scope is write-enabled (which would normally resolve to BLOCKER), the absence is of documentation/configuration rather than evidence of active violation. The database is on-premises at a fixed IP with no evidence it crosses jurisdictional boundaries.

findings.title: No PII Redaction Controls — Error Pages Expose Data
findings.description: No PII redaction. customErrors disabled exposes sensitive data (employee IDs, SQL queries) in error pages. Debug mode enabled amplifies exposure.
findings.gap: No PII redaction controls. Error pages expose sensitive data.
findings.recommendation: Enable customErrors. Implement PII masking middleware when adding logging.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or machine-readable specification exists.
findings.gap: Complete absence of machine-readable specifications.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI spec when building the new REST API layer.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error handling. customErrors disabled exposes raw stack traces. No error codes or retryable indicators.
findings.gap: No error codes, no machine-readable error bodies.
findings.recommendation: Implement consistent structured JSON error responses in the new API layer.

findings.title: State Only Queryable Through WebForms UI
findings.description: BindGrid provides read-before-write capability but only through browser UI interaction, not programmatic API.
findings.gap: State queryable only through WebForms UI, not programmatic API.
findings.recommendation: Expose GET endpoints for timesheet state in the new API layer.

findings.title: No Pagination or Query Filtering
findings.description: BindGrid retrieves all records for an employee with no pagination, filtering, or result size limits. Results are unbounded.
findings.gap: No pagination, filtering, or result size limits.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination (limit/offset or cursor), date range filtering, and sorting to the API.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerable
findings.description: Zero input validation. User inputs concatenated directly into SQL statements. SQL injection vulnerability present. No type checking or sanitization.
findings.gap: Complete absence of input validation. SQL injection via string concatenation.
findings.recommendation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with parameterized queries. Implement schema-based input validation.

findings.title: Incomplete Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Schema includes entry_date but no created_at, updated_at, or event_time. No timezone handling. No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Incomplete temporal metadata. No audit timestamps. No freshness signaling.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at and updated_at timestamps with UTC normalization to the data model.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema documentation, versioning, or API contracts. Database schema only visible through inline SQL strings.
findings.gap: Complete absence of schema versioning and contract management.
findings.recommendation: Document schema, implement migration tooling, add versioned API contracts.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing, no OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray, no structured logging, no correlation IDs. Zero observability instrumentation.
findings.gap: Complete absence of observability.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry SDK with X-Ray and structured JSON logging with correlation IDs.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No alerting. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no monitoring integration.
findings.gap: Complete absence of alerting.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on API error rates and P95 latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual Visual Studio publish to network share on Windows Server 2003/IIS 6. No peer review, no drift detection.
findings.gap: Complete absence of infrastructure governance.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as code (Terraform/CDK) with PR-based review and drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD. Manual deployment. No automated testing or contract testing.
findings.gap: Complete absence of CI/CD and contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual file-copy deployment. No blue/green, no canary, no CodeDeploy.
findings.gap: No automated rollback mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback triggers (CodeDeploy, blue/green).

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. No unit tests, integration tests, or API tests.
findings.gap: Zero test coverage.
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive API test suite as part of new API layer development.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE. No KMS keys configured.
findings.gap: Data at rest unencrypted. Database predates encryption support.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for SQL Server with KMS encryption at rest.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single-server production deployment with no non-production environments.
findings.gap: No safe environment for agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Create sandbox environment with synthetic timesheet data.

findings.title: HTML/ViewState Response Format
findings.description: Application returns rendered HTML with ViewState blobs. No JSON or structured data format for programmatic consumption.
findings.gap: No structured API response format. Only HTML rendering.
findings.recommendation: Ensure new API layer returns JSON with consistent schema.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge/SQS. State changes produce no events.
findings.gap: No event-driven integration possible.
findings.recommendation: Add event emission (SNS/EventBridge) for timesheet status changes.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented. No rate limit headers. No API Gateway usage plans.
findings.gap: No rate awareness signals for agents.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and return standard headers in new API.

findings.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
findings.description: Field names are semantically meaningful (employee_id, entry_date, hours, project). No data dictionary required.
findings.gap: None — field names are agent-interpretable.
findings.recommendation: Maintain semantic naming in the new API.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations >30s or long-running workflows.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no external service dependencies detected.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — not P0 priority, not on critical path.

evaluations.title: Data Quality Awareness
evaluations.reason: Informational-Absence Suppression: No data-quality tooling or metrics present and no contrary signal. INFO finding suppressed per scoring model.

evaluations.title: Data Catalog / Metadata Layer
evaluations.reason: Informational-Absence Suppression: No data catalog or metadata layer present and no contrary signal. INFO finding suppressed per scoring model.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: Informational-Absence Suppression: No metrics or telemetry surface exists at all. INFO finding suppressed per scoring model.

items.summary: Resolve all 5 BLOCKERs and address critical safety controls: build API layer, implement machine identity, add idempotency, implement compensation logic, and establish audit logging.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY findings (identity propagation, concurrency, blast radius, HITL) and RISK-QUALITY gaps (observability, engineering maturity, schema versioning).
Address remaining INFO-level architecture decisions and quality improvements (test coverage, event emission, response format).

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API layer over existing database
recommended_actions.rationale: The fundamental blocker — no programmatic interface exists. All other remediations depend on having an API surface.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with machine credentials
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine identity is required for any agent integration. Cannot enforce scoped permissions or audit without identity.

recommended_actions.action: Implement audit logging with immutable storage
recommended_actions.rationale: Write-enabled agent operations require full audit attribution for compliance and forensics.

recommended_actions.action: Add idempotency and compensation to write operations
recommended_actions.rationale: Agent retries and LLM non-determinism create duplicate operations without idempotency. No rollback path for failed multi-step sequences.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager
recommended_actions.rationale: Plaintext credentials in config are exposed to prompt injection or agent bugs.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy API Gateway with rate limiting and throttling
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevent runaway agent loops from overwhelming the application.

recommended_actions.action: Implement infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipeline
recommended_actions.rationale: Manual deployment prevents reliable rollback and contract testing.
